The opportunity
We are convinced that HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology, solutions for energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, is a long-term sustainable solution. The technology is used for energy transmission over long distances and to connect electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology also alleviates electricity quality problems and can contribute to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the only realistic energy transmission alternative.
In this role as a control & protection software design engineer at Hitachi Energy, you will be a part of a department which is responsible for automation systems and digital real-time control of the plants and transmissions. The need for this expertise is increasing and we are therefore looking for both freshly graduated students and senior engineers to join our team.
Are you ready to contribute to an ultra-relevant industry to save the planet? Do not hesitate to send your application. We appreciate potential and personal commitment equal to experience. We offer you an exciting and stimulating work environment, where you become an important team player collaborating to deliver our world-class technology and developing the best HVDC control for our customers.
This role is based in Ludvika, and possible to combine with working from your home-office.
How you´ll make an impact
You will be part of all phases of delivery, which includes design, maintenance, testing, integration, verification, and deployment of the HVDC control & protection application functions needed for safe and reliable operations of plants and transmission links.
Simulation studies
The position also includes documentation and customer trainings.
You are living Hitachi Energy´s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Sense of responsibility, and the capability of planning and organizing your daily work and a problem solver who takes initiatives to solve challenges.

Your background
You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree within the relevant technical area.
You have previous experience working with Control & Protection Design.
Experience in design and testing of control system.
You have an interest or skills within industrial application development and programming.
EMTDC/PSCAD skills or similar ones are required
As you will be a part of a global business, fluency in English is required, written and spoken alike. Swedish could also be beneficial.
Experience in digital technology, signal processing and control system design is seen as an advantage.
Experience from the power system industry - for example power system control and protection systems and automation, simulation and modelling procedures (real-time or offline) is also seen as an advantage in the role.

What we offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks
More benefits could be connected to this specific role

More about us 
Join Hitachi Energy and work in a team that is dedicated to creating a future where innovative digital technologies allow greater access to cleaner energy. We offer you an exciting and stimulating work environment, where you become an important team player collaborating to deliver our world-class technology and developing the best HVDC Control & Protection for our customers. We value you as a person and believe in personal development. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, please apply today, even if you do not meet all the criteria above. We are hiring for multiple positions.

Are you passionate about driving growth through digital media? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and commercial impact? Then this could be the role for you.

We are looking for a Digital Media Manager to help shape and develop how Tre works with paid digital media investments with a strong focus on performance marketing and traffic acquisition. This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly established role with significant influence, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution and a clear impact on business results.

About the roleAs Digital Media Manager, you will be responsible for Tre's paid digital media investments and the development of our performance media strategy. You will plan, prioritize, and optimize investments across the digital landscape together with our media agency focusing on channels such as Google, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and other relevant platforms.

You will work closely with both our Online and Commercial teams and serve as Tre's internal digital media expert. The role also involves close collaboration with external media agency, where you will act as a key point of contact.

To succeed in this role, you need to be both strategic and analytical. You are curious about what drives performance, comfortable challenging existing ways of working, and skilled at turning insights into recommendations that create tangible business value.

What you'll do

Own and develop Tre's digital media strategy, with a focus on traffic acquisition, media investments, and digital performance.
Plan, prioritize and evaluate digital campaigns while managing budgets, forecasting, and performance reporting.
Translate data and insights into actionable recommendations and drive strategic discussions with media agencies and internal stakeholders.
Collaborate across functions to identify new opportunities within digital marketing, AI, and automation.
Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert within digital media and performance marketing.

How hiring manager, Maria, describes her leadership style:  "I believe in a leadership style built on openness, transparency, and accessibility. We encourage dialogue, initiative, and the courage to try new things, while collaboration remains a key factor in our success. You'll join a fast-paced environment where people support one another, share knowledge, and work together towards common goals."

We believe you will bring the following:

Minimum 5 years of experience in digital media and performance marketing.
A strong understanding of the digital media landscape and how different channels, strategies, and buying models work together to drive business results.
Hands-on experience within platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, and other relevant advertising platforms.
Experience with analytics and marketing measurement, including attribution, digital analytics, or marketing mix modelling.
Knowledge of tracking, measurement, and data quality, with an interest in developing data-driven ways of working.
Experience managing large budgets and optimizing investments against business objectives.
The ability to transform complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and business value.
Experience leading projects and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across different functions.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
Experience working with traditional media and media agencies is highly valued, though not required.
Experience within the telecommunications industry is considered an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Who you are

You are analytical, commercially minded, and naturally curious. You enjoy diving into data and uncovering insights, while also being able to step back and see the bigger business picture. With a strong understanding of creative and effective communication, you know how to translate insights into actions that drive impact and business results.As this is a new role within Tre, you are comfortable creating structure where not everything is fully defined. You enjoy taking initiative, driving change, and bringing people along on the journey. At the same time, you are collaborative, humble, and focused on finding the best solutions together with others. You build strong relationships and establish trust with a variety of stakeholders, whether they are specialists, leaders, or external partners.We look forward to receiving your application!

Please apply through this job advertisement. We review applications on an ongoing basis. You do not need to submit a cover letter – simply attach your CV and answer the questions included in the application.

Here’s what the recruitment process looks like:

We start by reviewing applications, followed by assessments and a brief phone interview. You will then meet the hiring manager for an initial interview, followed by a competency-based interview with our Talent Acquisition Partner. For the final candidate, the process also includes reference checks and a background check.

Your role
Atlas Copco Group operates in a rapidly changing environment shaped by technological disruption, geopolitical uncertainty, shifting competitive dynamics and increasingly interconnected markets. Management needs more than summaries of external events. It needs a clear understanding of what is changing, why it matters, which business assumptions may be challenged and what should be monitored or explored further.
As Strategic Risk Intelligence Specialist, you will strengthen the forward-looking capabilities of Group Risk Management. You will combine strategic intelligence, scenario planning, analytics and AI-enabled research to support discussions across Business Areas, Divisions and Group Functions. This is not a traditional compliance, insurance or risk-administration role. It is a business-oriented analytical position focused on uncertainty and decision support.
Your mission is to convert complex and sometimes conflicting information into clear, evidence-based insight. You will help identify emerging developments, develop plausible scenarios, monitor critical assumptions and create concise material for management discussions. You will own the intelligence process and analytical preparation, working closely with the Vice President Group Risk Management & Insurance and colleagues across the Group.
Your day-to-day
Strategic intelligence and horizon scanning
Monitor and analyze macro trends, external developments and emerging signals relevant to the Group’s businesses, markets and operating environment. This includes industrial technology, AI, competition, geopolitics, trade, macroeconomics, sustainability, supply chains, customers and business-model change.
Produce concise intelligence reports, emerging-issue assessments and management briefings.
Maintain a structured, traceable repository of trends, signals and supporting evidence.

Scenario planning and strategic foresight
Develop plausible, differentiated and business-relevant scenarios.
Develop and monitor signposts covering material uncertainties.
Maintain a practical Group scenario library and support strategic stress testing and resilience assessments.
Recommend topics requiring deeper analysis, escalation or management attention.

Strategic risk analysis and decision support
Connect external intelligence with ERM, insurance and claims, loss prevention, supply-chain, resilience, financial and business information.
Develop dashboards and visualizations that clarify implications and choices.

AI-enabled risk intelligence
Use AI-enabled tools to improve horizon scanning, synthesis, scenario development and indicator monitoring.
Define business problems, expected value, information requirements and success criteria for potential AI use cases.
Work with the AI Expert, IT and data teams to develop appropriate solutions.

ERM and management reporting support
Prepare analyses, scenarios and assumption maps for objective-centric ERM workshops.
Add a forward-looking perspective to Group risk reporting and track management-attention topics over time.

Collaboration and capability development
Collaborate with Business Areas, Divisions, Group Functions and internal subject-matter experts to understand context and validate conclusions.
Work closely with colleagues in ERM, resilience, insurance, loss prevention, finance, strategy, IT, information security, legal and sustainability.
Build an effective network of external intelligence sources and internal expertise.
Share methods, tools and good practices for scenario analysis, assumption monitoring and AI-enabled 

Your skills and experience
What you bring
A master’s degree or equivalent qualification in engineering, economics, business administration, strategy, analytics, political science, international relations, technology or innovation management, or another relevant analytical field. Equivalent professional experience may also be considered
Approximately five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, strategic planning, business or market intelligence, strategic foresight, business development, risk analytics, enterprise risk management or data-driven business analysis.
Strong ability to structure ambiguous questions, synthesize large amounts of information and translate analysis into business implications.
Experience with scenario planning, strategic analysis, management reporting or comparable forward-looking analytical work.
Hands-on experience using generative AI and analytical tools, combined with a critical approach to output quality and source validation. Programming or scripting experience (e.g. Python, SQL) and familiarity with APIs and integrations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions, cultures and organizational levels.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

It is an advantage if you have
Experience from a global industrial, engineering or technology-driven organization.
Experience translating geopolitical, technological or competitive developments into business implications.
Experience with Power BI or comparable visualization tools, advanced Excel and executive presentation development.
Familiarity with ERM or GRC platforms and enterprise data environments.

Who you are
You are intellectually curious and motivated by understanding how the operating environment is changing. You enjoy connecting developments across technology, markets, competition, geopolitics and business strategy. You are comfortable with ambiguity but disciplined about evidence. You can develop a hypothesis without becoming attached to it and revise your view when the evidence changes.
You combine strategic thinking with practical execution. You do not stop at describing a trend. You ask why it matters, which assumptions may be affected, what evidence supports the conclusion, what would indicate that conditions are changing and how the insight could influence a management decision.
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

Do you enjoy helping colleagues, solving technical challenges, and improving systems and processes? Are you looking for a role where you can combine hands-on IT support with system administration, security, and improvement initiatives? If so, you might be the person we're looking for.
At Antaros Medical, we are pioneering imaging methods such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) to design and deliver clinical trials for decision-making and differentiation in drug development.
We value competence and development as much as ideas and solutions. Relationships and trust are key to success and having fun while doing meaningful work is just as important to us. We currently have about 160 employees at our offices in Sweden in Gothenburg, Uppsala, and Lund, as well as a subsidiary in the US, and we are continuously growing and developing.
As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an IT Support & System Administrator to join our team in Mölndal and help ensure a stable, secure, and efficient IT environment that supports Antaros Medical's employees, operations, and continued digitalization.
Role overview
In this broad and hands-on role, you will combine IT support, access management, system administration, and continuous improvement initiatives. Working closely with colleagues across the organization, you will help maintain day-to-day operations while contributing to the ongoing development of our IT environment and processes. 
Key responsibilities

Providing IT support and troubleshooting technical issues

Managing user accounts, permissions, and access requests

Administering and maintaining Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and other internal systems

Performing system maintenance, patching, upgrades, and implementations

Monitoring systems and investigating incidents

Supporting system lifecycle management activities

Participating in and driving IT, digitalization, and security-related initiatives

Identifying and implementing process and system improvements

Training and supporting internal users when needed

 This role offers significant ownership and autonomy and is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to broaden their experience within IT operations, infrastructure, security, and system administration.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who is service-oriented, collaborative, and enjoys helping others. You are analytical and solution-oriented, with a structured approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving. You are also proactive and self-driven, take ownership of your work, and actively look for ways to improve systems and processes. Finally, you are structured and detail-oriented, with an appreciation for quality, documentation, and well-defined processes.

Requirements

Post-secondary education in IT, computer science, systems administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience will also be considered.

At least 2 years of experience within IT support, helpdesk, system administration, or a similar role

Experience working with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID, and Intune

Good knowledge of Windows environments

Professional proficiency in English, spoken and written

Meritorious

Experience from Life Science, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries

Experience with Azure, AWS, or other public cloud platforms

Experience with system validation, testing, and change control processes

IT security experience

PowerShell scripting

Experience with Fortinet products or network administration

Knowledge of ISO 27001 and/or GAMP

 Are you interested?
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your application, including your CV, via the link below. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible, so don't wait to submit your application.
If you would like to learn more about the role, please contact Johannes Carlsson, VP IT, at +46 73 917 86 50. This is a permanent full-time position and includes a six-month probationary period. 
Applications are handled exclusively through our recruitment system, Teamtailor. The recruitment process is managed directly by Antaros Medical, and we kindly ask recruitment and staffing agencies not to contact us regarding this position.  
About Antaros Medical
At Antaros Medical, we combine ground-breaking imaging with profound experience in drug development and deep knowledge of disease mechanisms. We are specialized in cardiorenal & metabolic diseases and oncology. We have a global network of collaboration partners and customers, including both Big Pharma and Biotechs, and several European collaboration initiatives such as Innovative Medicines Initiative (IMI) and COST. 
Antaros Medical has delivered small complex, mechanistic studies as well as multi-center clinical trials worldwide utilizing our innovative imaging methods. Our global headquarter and imaging Corelab are based in Sweden, and we have recently opened a subsidiary in the US. If you want to find out more about our company, go to our website: www.antarosmedical.com 
Our culture is our people, and our values makes us everything that we are. Please feel free to have a look upon our Culture Handbook to get to know us even more: Our culture - Antaros Medical

The Opportunity
We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Plants who wants to take on a key role at HVDC in technical leadership in tenders and projects. You will have the responsibility to coordinate global teams with focus on Plants and Civil engineering design solutions and its interfaces for our onshore and offshore converter stations.  
As a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will drive strategic technical decision making, ensure that our design solutions meet customer requirements, quality standards and project goals. You interact with other stakeholders such as customers, contractors, supply chain and site team, contributing to the successful delivery of some of the world's most advanced energy infrastructure projects. The role is offering a unique opportunity to contribute to the global energy transition while working in a highly collaborative and international environment. This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.

"Are you ready to become part of a group of technical leaders with a passion for supporting our engineering teams and driving them forward? We work closely with many different functions and as a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will play a key role in driving transparency around technical solutions and their impact on projects that contribute to a greener future."
– Kamilla Sommarsjö, Global Head HVDC Lead Engineers - Plants

Provide strong technical leadership across Plants and Civil engineering teams and their interfaces.
Primary contact for technical communication with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
Drive completion of engineering activities in tenders and projects, working closely with technical leads, project managers, and interface managers.
Manage technical risks and ensure compliance with quality, safety and engineering processes.
Support installation and commissioning activities by providing expert technical guidance.
Lead development of new technical solutions while interpreting customer’s needs and expectations.
Take a strategic role in defining Plants and Civil solutions for onshore HVDC converter stations and offshore platforms.
Coordinate engineering activities across key disciplines, including:
Electromechanical Design
Station Auxiliary Power Systems
Civil Engineering
Auxiliary Systems (eg Fire Protection, HVAC, Security Systems)
Ensure effective coordination and management of interfaces between engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.
Represent the Plants discipline in customer meetings, partner discussions, and technical reviews.

Your Background
Academic degree in Engineering (for example within Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related area)
At least 5 years of engineering experience, including experience of leading technical teams, multidisciplinary engineering activities or complex projects is required.
Experience within HVDC, transmission systems, substations, electrical power systems, offshore wind, or other large-scale energy infrastructure projects is highly valued.
Strong technical understanding with the ability to quickly develop expertise in HVDC technology and systems.
A collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders across functions and geographic locations.
Strong leadership skills and the confidence to make technical decisions when required.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical solutions in a clear and structured manner.
Fluency in English, both verbally and written, is required. Other languages are an advantage.

As a person, you are passionate about both people and technology. You thrive in a dynamic environment, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are motivated by solving complex technical challenges together with others.

Description of workplaceThe research group is led by Associated professor Sandra Lindstedt and has a long-standing interest in research related to lung transplantation, post-transplant complications, and lung regeneration. The group focuses on developing novel therapeutic strategies to treat lung injury, improve donor organ quality, and reduce complications following lung transplantation. A particular focus is on acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), primary graft dysfunction (PGD), and regenerative approaches to lung repair.
We offerLund University is a governmental authority, which means you get special benefits, generous holidays, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university's website about being employed at Lund University, Work at Lund University
Work descriptionA associate researcher position is available within the Lindstedt research group, focusing on translational research in lung transplantation, lung injury, and regenerative medicine. The duties at the research unit primarily consist of experimental and laboratory-based research, with a particular focus on the development and evaluation of novel therapeutic strategies to improve lung repair and transplantation outcomes.
The main responsibilities include:
independently designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting research projects, as well as collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and managing experimental data.
The work involves the development and optimization of experimental protocols, evaluation of therapeutic interventions, and application of cellular, molecular, ultra-high-plexed immunofluorescence and histological techniques to investigate mechanisms of lung injury, repair, and regeneration.
The position also includes responsibility for preparing high-quality scientific manuscripts for publication in international peer-reviewed journals, contributing to research grant applications, and presenting research findings at national and international scientific conferences.
The majority of the work will be conducted independently, while also involving close collaboration with internal and external research partners and clinical collaborators.
In addition, the position includes mentorship and supervision of doctoral students, Bachelor’s and Master’s students, and other junior researchers, as well as contributing to the coordination and development of ongoing research activities within the group.

Other work tasks might also be included.
QualificationsRequired qualifications
PhD (or equivalent) in biomedical sciences, biotechnology, molecular biology, regenerative medicine, or a related field.
A minimum of four years of documented research experience following completion of the PhD, demonstrating scientific independence and responsibility.
Documented experience in experimental and translational biomedical research, particularly within cell therapies, lung injury, lung transplantation, or regenerative medicine.
Hands-on experience with small and large-animal models and/or ex vivo organ perfusion.
Experience with standard cellular and molecular biology techniques, including cell culture, ELISA, Western blotting, qPCR, immunohistochemistry and high-plexed immunofluorescence.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, plan, coordinate, and conduct complex experimental research projects.
Documented scientific productivity through publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Independent and responsible, with the ability to organize and manage research activities and take responsibility for scientific quality and project progress.
Collaborative, with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary research environments.
Analytical and solution-oriented, with the ability to critically evaluate experimental results and address complex scientific challenges.

Meritorious qualifications:
Additional specialized training in experimental transplantation, regenerative medicine, cell therapy, or related disciplines.
Relevant training and certification in laboratory animal science, particularly involving large- and small-animal experimental models.
Completed courses in higher education teaching and pedagogy.
Experience with experimental lung transplantation, including large- and small-animal models of lung injury and transplantation.
Hands-on experience with ex vivo lung perfusion (EVLP) and human ex vivo lung models, including precision-cut lung slices (PCLS).
Experience in the development and evaluation of cell-based and regenerative therapies, particularly mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) and mitochondrial therapeutics.
Experience with cellular, molecular, histological, and proteomic analyses, including the handling and processing of human and animal tissue samples.
Experience in managing and coordinating interdisciplinary research projects and national or international collaborations.
Documented experience in scientific supervision, preparation of research grant applications, and dissemination of research findings through publications and international conferences.

Other information
The position is a fixed-term employment according to the Special Fixed-term Employment (SÄVA) regulations §5 p1 LAS, and it is full-time. The desired start date is 2027-01-01 or as agreed upon, with an end date of 2027-12-31.

Company Description

Bosch Home Comfort in Tranås develops, manufactures and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources: rock, water and air. Our Tranås site brings together manufacturing, research and development, and business functions, creating an environment where ideas and decisions are closely connected to our products and operations.
We believe in technology that makes a difference: Invented for life.
 

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers?
As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing, partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.
You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.
Your key responsibilities
Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions.
Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs.
Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures.
Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations.
Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control.
Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role.
Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable.
We are looking for someone with:
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel
Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage
Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement

Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box. We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights.
Who you are
You are curious about the business behind the numbers. When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset.
You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.

Additional Information

Why join us in Tranås?
In Tranås, more than 600 associates work across manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a more sustainable future.
For a Plant Controller, this creates an exciting environment where you can see the connection between the numbers, the decisions and what actually happens in the factory.
The role gives you broad exposure to manufacturing finance, product costing, investments and operational performance, while working within the international Bosch organization. It is an opportunity to deepen your controlling expertise, influence the business and continue developing your career.
At Bosch, we value openness, trust and different perspectives, and we want our associates to have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.
What we offer
Competitive compensation
Pension, insurance and other benefits in accordance with our collective agreement
Flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities where compatible with the role
Employee discounts on Bosch products
Development opportunities within an international Bosch organization

Regular presence at our Tranås site is an important part of the role because of the close collaboration with our manufacturing organization.
If you enjoy combining finance, manufacturing and problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.
